beginner.zh: 傳統醫療常以「平均的病人」設計治療；精準醫療則考慮每個人在基因、環境與生活型態的差異，找出更適合的預防與治療方式。
beginner.en: Traditional care is often designed for the "average patient"; precision medicine considers each person's genes, environment and lifestyle to choose better prevention and treatment.

advanced.zh: 美國 Precision Medicine Initiative（2015）近期以癌症為重點，長期擴及所有疾病。基因資訊只是其中一部分，必須與臨床資料、環境暴露和生活型態整合；並非所有基因檢測結果都能改變臨床決策。
advanced.en: The US Precision Medicine Initiative (2015) focused near-term on cancer and long-term on all disease. Genetic information is one component, integrated with clinical data, environment and lifestyle; not every genetic result changes clinical decisions.

zh: 依腫瘤的分子特徵選擇治療，而非只看腫瘤長在哪個器官。
en: Choosing therapy by a tumour's molecular profile, not only by the organ it arose in.

beginner.zh: 「風險高三倍」聽起來很可怕，但如果原本機率是 1%，三倍也只是 3%。相對風險不等於絕對風險；而且基因之外，環境與生活也很重要。
beginner.en: "Three times the risk" sounds scary, but if the baseline is 1%, three times is 3%. Relative risk is not absolute risk — and environment and lifestyle matter beyond genes.

advanced.zh: PRS 研究多以相對風險（如前 x% 與其餘人口比較的 OR）報告。絕對風險 = 基準發生率 × 相對風險（在罕見結果下近似），需要目標族群的年齡、性別別發生率。Khera 等人也指出臨床需同時評估並溝通兩者。
advanced.en: PRS studies usually report relative risk (e.g. OR of top x% vs the rest). Absolute risk ≈ baseline incidence × relative risk (for rare outcomes) and requires age- and sex-specific incidence in the target population. Khera et al. note both must be assessed and communicated clinically.

zh: （模擬）基準 10 年風險 2%、相對風險 1.5 → 絕對風險約 3%。
en: (Simulated) Baseline 10-year risk 2%, relative risk 1.5 → absolute risk ≈ 3%.

beginner.zh: 預測是「估計機率」，不是「判決」。高風險的人不一定會生病，低風險的人也可能生病。預測結果要交由醫師結合其他資訊判讀。
beginner.en: Prediction estimates probability; it is not a verdict. High-risk people may stay well and low-risk people may get sick. Results should be interpreted by clinicians with other information.

advanced.zh: Khera 2018 主張可考慮將 PRS 納入臨床（冠狀動脈疾病高 PRS 族群的盛行率為同等風險單基因突變攜帶者的 20 倍），但這是英國血統單一世代的結果；Martin 2019 則警告跨族群準確度不一。PRS 引導篩檢是否改善臨床結果，目前本系統尚無可驗證證據（Pending）。
advanced.en: Khera 2018 proposed considering PRS in clinical care (high-PRS prevalence 20× that of monogenic carriers with comparable CAD risk), but in a single British-ancestry cohort; Martin 2019 warns of uneven accuracy across ancestries. Whether PRS-guided screening improves outcomes has no verified evidence in this system (Pending).

zh: 同一 PRS 結果，搭配年齡、血壓、膽固醇等臨床因子，才較能估計個人風險。
en: A PRS combined with age, blood pressure and cholesterol gives a better individual risk estimate.

beginner.zh: 癌症是細胞的 DNA 出現後天變化而失控生長。分析腫瘤的突變、RNA 與其他分子資料，可以了解癌症類型並尋找治療方向。
beginner.en: Cancer arises when acquired DNA changes make cells grow out of control. Analysing a tumour's mutations, RNA and other molecules helps classify it and find treatment options.

advanced.zh: TCGA 在 DNA、RNA、蛋白質與表觀遺傳層次分析大量腫瘤；Pan-Cancer 比較 12 種腫瘤類型的共通性與差異。癌症基因體以 somatic 變異為主，需配對正常組織區分 germline 背景。
advanced.en: TCGA profiled many tumours at DNA, RNA, protein and epigenetic levels; Pan-Cancer compared commonalities and differences across 12 tumour types. Cancer genomics focuses on somatic variants, using matched normal tissue to separate germline background.

zh: 腫瘤–正常配對定序：只在腫瘤出現的變異視為 somatic。
en: Tumour–normal paired sequencing: variants present only in the tumour are somatic.

beginner.zh: 研究上的發現要用在病人身上，需要合格實驗室檢測、專業人員判讀，以及清楚的風險溝通。這個網站是教材，不是診斷工具。
beginner.en: Using research findings for patients requires certified labs, expert interpretation and clear risk communication. This website is teaching material, not a diagnostic tool.

advanced.zh: ACMG 建議臨床分子遺傳檢測於 CLIA 認證實驗室進行，由具認證的專家判讀，並以五級分類描述孟德爾疾病變異。研究級 PRS 與臨床檢測之間仍需驗證效度、效用、族群適用性與倫理規範。
advanced.en: ACMG recommends clinical molecular genetic testing in CLIA-approved labs with board-certified interpretation and five-tier classification for Mendelian variants. Research-grade PRS still needs validity, utility, population applicability and ethical safeguards before clinical use.

zh: 消費者基因檢測的結果，不能直接當作臨床診斷。
en: Direct-to-consumer genetic results are not a clinical diagnosis.

beginner.zh: 基因資料可以辨識個人、也牽涉家人，必須保護隱私。若研究只包含少數族群，工具可能對其他人比較不準，造成不公平。
beginner.en: Genetic data can identify a person and implicates relatives, so privacy must be protected. If research includes only some groups, tools may be less accurate for others, creating inequity.

advanced.zh: Martin 2019 主張公平的 PRS 需要提升研究族群多樣性並公開 summary statistics；Popejoy 2016 記錄 GWAS 族群組成偏差。其他議題包括知情同意、資料再識別風險、結果回饋與歧視風險。
advanced.en: Martin 2019 argues equitable PRS requires diverse cohorts and public summary statistics; Popejoy 2016 documents the skewed ancestry of GWAS. Other issues include informed consent, re-identification risk, return of results and discrimination.

zh: 本專案只使用模擬基因型，不收集任何個人資料。
en: This project uses only simulated genotypes and collects no personal data.
